contents: A localization of a ring is flat over the original ring.
slogan: Localization preserves flatness and flatness can be checked locally.

contents: A module is flat exactly when all of its localizations at prime ideals are flat.
slogan: Localization preserves flatness and flatness can be checked locally.

contents: A finite module over a local ring is zero when its product with the maximal ideal equals itself.
slogan: Nakayama's lemma detects when finite modules vanish.

contents: A finite module is generated by lifts of generators modulo the maximal ideal.
slogan: Nakayama's lemma detects when finite modules vanish.

contents: The spectrum of a nonzero ring contains a maximal ideal.
slogan: Every nonzero ring has prime and maximal ideals.
